description: This file defines a `GatewayServiceResolver` class that performs Bonjour service resolution using `NetService`, encapsulating asynchronous address resolution logic with a callback mechanism.

classes.name: GatewayServiceResolver
classes.description: A class that resolves Bonjour services using NetService, providing a callback with the host and port once resolved.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the resolver with service name, type, domain, and a completion callback.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the resolution process with an optional timeout.

methods.name: netServiceDidResolveAddress
methods.description: Delegate method called when the service address is successfully resolved.

methods.name: netService
methods.description: Delegate method called when the service fails to resolve.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Completes the resolution process, invoking the callback and cleaning up.
